wound_cleaning.ability_reason: Washed wounds fester less; cuts and bites stop killing the strong.

delousing.name: Delousing
delousing.observation: Kin comb each other's hair with fine bone combs and crush the lice, and the itching fevers come less often.

herbal_classification.ability_reason: Healing plants known apart from food and poison give the sick a remedy instead of a guess.

birth_attendants.ability_reason: No mother labors alone; difficult births are met by women who have seen them before.

snakebite_treatment.name: Snakebite and Sting Care
snakebite_treatment.observation: A bitten limb is bound above the wound, cut and sucked, and the victim is kept still and watched.

joint_reduction.name: Resetting Dislocated Joints
joint_reduction.observation: A healer braces a foot against the body and pulls a dislocated shoulder or hip back into place with a practised twist.

clean_water.ability_reason: Drinking upstream of washing and herds ends much of the summer sickness that kills children.

wound_packing.name: Wound Packing
wound_packing.observation: Dried moss, lint and soft leaves packed into a wound soak up blood and keep dirt out.

poultices.name: Poultices
poultices.observation: Crushed leaves bound with clay and fat draw heat from swellings and ease sore joints.

sweat_baths.name: Sweat Baths
sweat_baths.observation: Water thrown on hot stones in a closed hut fills it with steam, and people sweat out aches and grime together.

purges_emetics.name: Purges and Emetics
purges_emetics.observation: Bitter roots given to a poisoned or bloated person empty the gut, and sometimes the patient with it.

tooth_drilling.name: Tooth Drilling
tooth_drilling.observation: A flint point spun on a bow drill cleans out a rotten tooth, and a plug of beeswax stops the ache.

boil_lancing.name: Lancing Boils
boil_lancing.observation: A boil opened with a sharp flake and pressed clean heals faster than one left to swell.

disability_care.name: Care for the Lame
disability_care.observation: Kin feed and carry those who can no longer walk or hunt, and the lame live on for years.
disability_care.social_consequence: The lame and the old stay at the hearth to teach, mend and remember; losing a limb no longer means losing a life.

poppy_analgesia.name: Poppy for Pain
poppy_analgesia.observation: Latex scraped from cut poppy heads dulls pain and brings sleep, though too much brings a sleep with no waking.

refuse_removal.name: Refuse Out of the Dwelling
refuse_removal.observation: Dung, bones and ash are swept out and dumped downwind, and houses smell and sicken less.

trepanation.name: Trepanation
trepanation.observation: A healer scrapes away shattered skull bone with a flint blade, and many of those opened live on with the wound healed over.
trepanation.social_consequence: The skull healer is feared and honoured; the survivors carry their healed scars as proof of the healer's power.

crutches.name: Crutches and Staffs
crutches.observation: A forked staff under the arm lets someone with a broken leg move and work while the bone knits.

heatstroke_care.name: Care for the Heat-Struck
heatstroke_care.observation: A worker who staggers in the midday sun is laid in shade, wetted and given water, and is back at work in a day.

honey_wound_dressing.name: Honey Wound Dressing
honey_wound_dressing.observation: Wounds spread with honey and bound stay clean and heal where others turn foul.

sickroom_fumigation.name: Fumigated Sickrooms
sickroom_fumigation.observation: Smouldering herbs fill the sickroom with smoke to drive out bad air, and the room is aired and swept after.

kohl_eye_paint.name: Green Eye Paint
kohl_eye_paint.observation: Ground green malachite painted round the eyes keeps off flies and glare, and eye sickness is rarer among those who wear it.

bracket_fungus_vermifuge.name: Fungus Against Gut Worms
bracket_fungus_vermifuge.observation: Birch bracket fungus eaten as a remedy drives worms from the gut, and thin children fill out again.

head_shaving_lice.name: Shaved Heads Against Lice
head_shaving_lice.observation: Children and workers keep their hair cropped or shaved, and the lice have nowhere to breed.

skin_oiling.name: Skin Oiling
skin_oiling.observation: Oil rubbed into the skin keeps it from cracking in wind and burning in sun.

traction_fracture_setting.name: Traction for Fractures
traction_fracture_setting.observation: Two helpers pull a broken limb straight while the healer sets the ends and binds it, and the leg heals true rather than short.

castor_oil_remedies.name: Castor Oil Remedies
castor_oil_remedies.observation: Oil pressed from castor seeds purges the gut and soothes skin, but the raw seed kills.

healing_chants.name: Healing Chants
healing_chants.observation: Remedies are given with chants and names of power, and the sick take them with more trust and rest more calmly.

river_bathing.name: River Bathing
river_bathing.observation: People bathe in running water below the drinking place, and skin sores and rashes grow rare.

fly_protection.name: Covered Food and Fly Whisks
fly_protection.observation: Food is kept under cloth and lids and flies are whisked from infants, and the summer flux takes fewer small children.

wound_suturing.name: Stitched Wounds
wound_suturing.observation: A gaping wound is drawn closed with thread and a bone needle, and it heals in a clean line instead of a festering gap.

latrine_siting.ability_reason: Latrines dug downslope and away from wells keep the drinking water clean.
latrine_siting.social_consequence: Where people may relieve themselves becomes a rule of the settlement, enforced by neighbours.

water_settling_basins.ability_reason: Settled water is clearer and brings less sickness.

isolation_practice.ability_reason: Setting the sick apart in an outbreak spares the rest of the household.

woven_dressings.ability_reason: Clean woven linen for dressings keeps wounds covered and dry.

protected_wellheads.ability_reason: A covered wellhead keeps dung, animals and runoff out of the water.

separate_clean_water_storage.ability_reason: Drinking water kept apart from washing water stays fit to drink.

ash_fat_soap.name: Ash-and-Fat Soap
ash_fat_soap.observation: Fat boiled with wood-ash lye makes a soap that lifts grease from skin, wool and wounds.

copper_razors.name: Copper Razors
copper_razors.observation: Thin copper blades shave heads and bodies clean, and priests and healers keep themselves hairless for purity.

healer_titles.name: Healer Titles
healer_titles.observation: The physician, the tooth-healer and the eye-healer are named offices, and people know whom to send for.
healer_titles.social_consequence: Healing becomes a calling with rank and pay; a title is earned by long service and lost by failure.

embalming_anatomy.name: Organs Known from the Dead
embalming_anatomy.observation: Those who prepare the dead learn where the heart, liver and lungs lie, and healers learn it from them.

public_baths.ability_reason: Public washing places let every household wash, not only those with water at the door.
public_baths.social_consequence: The washing place becomes where neighbours meet; bathing becomes a daily custom.

linen_board_splints.name: Linen-Bound Board Splints
linen_board_splints.observation: Shaped boards padded and bound with linen bands hold a broken limb straight for weeks.

remedy_vehicles.name: Remedies in Beer, Milk and Honey
remedy_vehicles.observation: Bitter remedies are stirred into beer, milk or honey, and children and the weak take the full dose.

mineral_eye_salves.name: Mineral Eye Salves
mineral_eye_salves.observation: Ground copper and lead ores mixed into salves clear weeping eyes, though the lead does harm of its own.

wired_teeth.name: Wired Teeth
wired_teeth.observation: A loose tooth bound to its neighbours with fine gold or copper wire stays in the jaw to chew with.

willow_myrtle_remedies.name: Willow and Myrtle Remedies
willow_myrtle_remedies.observation: Willow bark and myrtle leaf steeped and drunk ease pain and cool fevers, including those after childbirth.

remedy_tablets.name: Remedy Tablets
remedy_tablets.observation: Remedies are written down with their ingredients, preparation and use, so a healer far away can make the same cure.
remedy_tablets.social_consequence: Healing knowledge no longer dies with the healer; scribes and physicians begin to work together.

case_records.ability_reason: Remedies written beside their outcomes show which cures work and which only seem to.

skin_disease_exclusion.name: Exclusion of Scaly-Skin Sufferers
skin_disease_exclusion.observation: Those with scaling, spreading skin disease are made to live outside the walls, and the sickness spreads less within.
skin_disease_exclusion.social_consequence: The excluded live apart on charity; fear of the disease hardens into a lasting stigma.

mad_dog_liability.name: Liability for Mad Dogs
mad_dog_liability.observation: An owner warned that his dog is mad must pay a fine if it bites someone, so dangerous dogs are tied or killed.

womens_ailment_texts.name: Women's-Ailment Texts
womens_ailment_texts.observation: Written remedies for barrenness, difficult pregnancy and bleeding after birth pass between healers and midwives.

healer_fee_law.name: Healer Fees by Law
healer_fee_law.observation: The law sets a healer's fee by the patient's rank, and fines or maims the healer whose knife kills.
healer_fee_law.social_consequence: Healers weigh the risk of each cure against the penalty; careful healers prosper and reckless ones flee.

injury_manual.name: Injury Manual
injury_manual.observation: A written manual takes each injury from head to foot: how to examine it, judge it, and treat it or leave it alone.
injury_manual.social_consequence: Healers learn to refuse hopeless cases openly; judgement, not only remedy, becomes their craft.

cautery.name: Cautery
cautery.observation: A fire-drill heated in the coals seals a bleeding vessel or a festering wound, at the cost of a burn.

pulse_taking.name: Pulse Taking
pulse_taking.observation: Healers feel the heartbeat at wrist and neck, and learn to tell a failing pulse from a steady one.

remedy_compendia.name: Remedy Compendia
remedy_compendia.observation: Great rolls gather hundreds of remedies by ailment, copied from temple to temple and consulted at the bedside.
